messages:
Priya: heads-up — new model intake: cobalt-14b-v1 (14B, 8k context, fp16 baseline). Requesting quantization plan + calibration run. Pilot priority = P1 (product pilot mid-Apr). Goal: stay within 0.8% avg nll delta and <2x token cost reduction baseline. :eyes:
Alex: ack. propose a gated/hybrid path: gguf export -> int8 symmetric for MLPs, fp8 for attn & lm_head, and fallback to fp16 for failing evals. Reason: preserve attention numerical fidelity.
Priya: sounds reasonable. we need concrete thresholds and an eval harness. Jin can you define the eval set?
Jin: yes — I'll assemble 2k prompts: 50% longcontext, 30% instruction, 20% safety/regression checks. Will include the product prompt pool + 300 adversarial qa items. Target metrics: nll, perplexity, exact-match subsets, and embedding-similarity for semantic drift.
Alex: plan of action (short):
1) export model -> gguf
2) run quant calib: int8 baseline, fp8 hybrid sensitivity on attention
3) run eval harness and compute regression buckets
4) if >0.8% nll or >5% perf regressions on critical prompts -> revert to fp16 for problematic layers or use per-layer mixed precision
Snippets:
```bash
# export
rw-model-export --src s3://models/cobalt-14b-v1 --out /tmp/cobalt.gguf
# calib int8
python tools/calibrate.py --model /tmp/cobalt.gguf --precision int8 --calib-data ./calib/cobalt --output /tmp/cobalt_int8.gguf
# hybrid fp8 on attn
python tools/calibrate.py --model /tmp/cobalt.gguf --precision hybrid --attn-precision fp8 --mlp-precision int8 --calib-data ./calib/cobalt
```
Sam: for Dedicated rollout, recommend canary 5% traffic with autoscale + latency SLO 200ms P95. Also add routing policy to fallback to hosted fp16 variant on errors.
Priya: cost target: token unit cost <= 0.6x baseline (baseline = fp16 hosted). If hybrid meets quality but only 0.7x cost, acceptable. Anything >0.8x we deprioritize.
calib-bot: Calibration job queued — job_id=cb-1951234-01, expected runtime ~2h.
Alex: quick note on calibration dataset: include both short and long sequences, calibrate with sequences truncated/padded to 2048 and 8192 to capture KV cache behavior. Also enable per-channel scaling for weight ranges.
Jin: eval harness will output: nll_delta, p95_latency, embedding_cos_sim, and a labeled list of failing prompts. I'll set gating thresholds: nll_delta <= 0.008 (0.8%), embedding_cos_sim >= 0.985 avg, no critical prompt failures (critical = product hits).
Priya: ok assign: Alex -> run export + calibrations, Jin -> prepare eval dataset and run harness, Sam -> prepare canary route on Dedicated and fallback policy. Timeline: start today, initial results by EOD tomorrow.
Alex: started export, posting logs if anything fails.
calib-bot: job cb-1951234-01 started at 1951234580.
Sam: I'll stub canary config in staging: routing rule + metrics dashboard.
Priya: perfect. ping here when first eval table is available. :thumbsup:
